title: Scheduled time plus signed delay
description: Replace the pill with an explicit delay chip in the eta cell: the scheduled clock time and how many minutes later the live estimate lands — '07:50 +6'. Names the delay a rider is experiencing, in green. Because eta is floored at schedule, the delta is always >= 0 and never reads as an early departure.
baseline_ref: app/components/ArrivalRow.vue: scheduledTimeDisplay renders 'HH:mm →'; Arrival carries eta and scheduledEta (seconds)

changes.intent: Derive the schedule clock string and the whole-minute lateness from the two timestamps already on the arrival.
changes.detail: Add a computed that, when arrival.estimated && scheduledEta != null && scheduledEta !== eta, returns { sched: formatted scheduledEta as HH:mm (es-CR, 24h), delta: Math.round((eta - scheduledEta) / 60) }. Returns null otherwise (falls back to a plain countdown).

changes.intent: Show the delay chip before the countdown instead of the estimado pill.
changes.detail: Remove the .arrival-row__badge--estimated pill and the .arrival-row__scheduled span. When deltaDisplay is set, render {{ sched }}+{{ delta }} before the number.

changes.intent: Read as a small supporting annotation; the +N should stand out in the live/ok green.
Emphasise the lateness value in the live token.
